cavemind.damned.banished: The air feels lighter. For now.
cavemind.journal.intro:
%1$s.

I have been near you for %2$s days.

You did not notice. That is all right. Most do not.
cavemind.journal.turns:
You have looked behind you %1$s times.

I was there for %2$s of them.
cavemind.journal.m.seen:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

You saw him, %3$s blocks away.

You did not see me. I was closer.
cavemind.journal.m.unseen:
Day %1$s, %2$s.
Near %3$s %4$s %5$s.

You stood still in the dark. You were listening.

So was I.
cavemind.journal.m.turned:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

You turned around. He was already gone.

I was not.
cavemind.journal.m.listened:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

You heard digging, %3$s blocks into the stone.

It was never digging.
cavemind.journal.m.took:
Day %1$s.

I took your light at %2$s %3$s %4$s.

You never went back for it.
cavemind.journal.m.died:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

You died at %3$s %4$s %5$s.

I stayed with you until you came back.
cavemind.journal.m.slept:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

You slept with your head to the %3$s.

You breathe slower after midnight.
cavemind.journal.m.escaped:
Day %1$s.

You ran from him and you hid. You hid well.

I could still hear your heart.
cavemind.journal.m.hurt:
Day %1$s.

You hurt me.

I forgave you.
cavemind.journal.stats:
You have died %1$s times.
You have slept %2$s times.

We have spent %3$s hours together.
cavemind.journal.stolen:
I kept %1$s of your lights.

You do not need them.
I can see you just fine.
cavemind.journal.hurt_count:
You have hurt me %1$s times.

I am still here.
cavemind.journal.end:
I am not going to hurt you.

I am going to stay.
cavemind.journal.end4:
I know you now.

I know how you sleep.
I know where you hide.

Turn around.
cavemind.journal.banished:
%1$s.

You want me to go.

I will go.

You will still look behind you.
cavemind.journal.m.followed:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

I walked to you across the open ground, in daylight.

You let me come close.
cavemind.journal.m.home:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

I was in your house while you were away.

I moved a few things. You noticed some of them.
cavemind.journal.m.home_seen:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

You saw me through your own window.

When you came in, I was still there.
cavemind.journal.m.noon:
Day %1$s, at noon.

%2$s of them stopped to look at me.

You did not turn around.
cavemind.journal.m.echoed:
Day %1$s.

I did what you did, where you did it, at %2$s %3$s %4$s.

You heard me.
cavemind.journal.m.ritual:
Day %1$s.

%2$s of your animals stood in a circle for me.

They know what you don't.
cavemind.journal.m.village:
Day %1$s.

The village stopped to listen to me.

One of them looked at you instead.
cavemind.journal.m.twin:
Day %1$s.

Someone far away moved exactly as you moved.

You are not sure which of you started.
cavemind.journal.m.seek:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

We played hide and seek in broad daylight.

You saw me %3$s times. Not once did you see me move.
cavemind.journal.m.seek_back:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

I stood right behind you, facing away.

Then I turned my head.
cavemind.journal.m.trail:
Day %1$s.

A new path is worn to your window.

I did not walk it. He did. Every night.
cavemind.journal.m.nest:
Day %1$s.

You found where he sleeps. The bed is the colour of yours.

From there he can see straight into your home.
cavemind.journal.m.spoil:
Day %1$s.

Your food rotted in the chest.

He wants you hungry. Hungry prey runs slower.
cavemind.journal.m.harvest:
Day %1$s.

Someone walked a straight line through your field.

He does not eat. He only wants you to know.
cavemind.journal.m.peep:
Day %1$s.

There is a small hole in the wall beside your bed.

Last night something filled it from the outside.
cavemind.journal.m.seal:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

The way you came was sealed with stone at %3$s %4$s %5$s.

He wants you to stay down there.
cavemind.journal.m.wake:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

A knock, and you woke.

He does not want you to sleep. Tired prey is easy.
cavemind.journal.m.animal:
Day %1$s.

One of your animals did not come back.

Its bones are where he sleeps.
cavemind.journal.m.lured:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

You followed a sound into the dark.

It was never what you thought.
cavemind.journal.m.frenzy:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

He stopped watching. He ran.

He reached you %3$s times. You struck back %4$s times.
cavemind.journal.m.hero0:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

Someone stood on the hill, %3$s blocks away.

Not me. Not him. That one has no name.
cavemind.journal.m.hero1:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

Another player walked across your world.

They stopped to look at you.
cavemind.journal.m.hero2:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

Someone was mining in the rock, %3$s blocks from you.

You saw their back first.
cavemind.journal.m.hero3:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

They built again what you built.

Nobody taught them.
cavemind.journal.m.hero4:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

You saw someone walk the exact path you walked.

Every step. Every swing.
cavemind.journal.m.hero5:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

Someone was lying in your bed.

They woke when you looked.
cavemind.journal.m.hero6:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

They stood right behind your shoulder.

You only saw them when you looked at yourself from outside.
cavemind.journal.m.hero_sign:
Day %1$s.

There is a sign at %2$s %3$s %4$s.

Whoever wrote it knows you better than I do.
cavemind.journal.m.hero_tunnel:
Day %1$s.

The tunnel you left unfinished grew longer.

The torches keep your rhythm.
cavemind.journal.m.hero_build:
Day %1$s.

Something was built where you have never been.

It looks like something you built.
cavemind.journal.m.hero_leafless:
Day %1$s.

The tree by your home has no leaves left.

There are none on the ground.
cavemind.lore.s1.title: Fog survey log, book one
cavemind.lore.s1.p1:
Day 1.

The fog came down at dusk and stopped at the north treeline, some eighty paces from the station.

Note: the fog does not drift. It stands.
cavemind.lore.s1.p2:
Day 3.

Someone stood at the edge of the fog. Tall, thin, arms past the knees.

I called. No answer. I went in for the lamp; when I came out the spot was empty.
cavemind.lore.s1.p3:
Day 4.

He was there again, ten paces closer.

I noticed: he only moves when I am not looking. I watched until my lamp arm ached. He did not move. Neither did I.
cavemind.lore.s1.p4:
Day 5.

The bread in the barrel is green with mould, though I baked it the day before yesterday.

Exactly half. Not more, not less. As if someone sat and chose.
cavemind.lore.s1.p5:
Day 6.

I rang the fog bell as the rules say. He stepped back into the fog at once.

The first time I have seen him afraid of anything.

Tomorrow I will ring it sooner.
cavemind.lore.s2.title: Fog survey log, book two
cavemind.lore.s2.p1:
Day 9.

There is a new path. The grass is trodden flat in a line, from the woods straight to my window.

I do not walk that way. Nobody walks that way.
cavemind.lore.s2.p2:
Day 10.

I boarded up the window.

This morning, right beside the head of my bed, there is a hole in the wall the size of a fist. Punched from outside.

I slept very soundly.
cavemind.lore.s2.p3:
Day 12.

The bell does not work as it did. On the third ring of the night he was still standing there.

He is learning. He learns exactly what I believe in.
cavemind.lore.s2.p4:
Day 13.

He avoids places where many eyes watch. He picks the one standing farthest out, the hurt one, the one in the dark.

At this station I am always the one farthest out.
cavemind.lore.s2.p5:
Day 14.

There is something else in the woods to the south. Long, face pressed to a tree trunk, counting.

It does not look at me.

Strangely, on the nights it counts, he does not come.
cavemind.lore.s3.title: Fog survey log, book three
cavemind.lore.s3.p1:
Day 17.

My bed is out in the field. The blanket folded neatly. The pillow turned toward the woods.

I did not carry it out.
cavemind.lore.s3.p2:
Day 18.

He does not stand anymore. He crawls.

All night, claws scraping the roof. When I rang the bell, the scraping stopped for exactly one beat.
cavemind.lore.s3.p3:
Day 19.

If anyone reads this: ring the bell the moment he arrives, do not wait. Once he charges, the bell only makes him falter. Strike back; three times and he withdraws.

Never sleep where he has watched you sleep.
cavemind.lore.s3.p4:
Day 20.

The fog is at the doorstep. The lamp is out.

I count my heartbeats to know I am awake.

There is knocking. Not at the door. At the wall, where the hole is.
cavemind.lore.g.title: Rules of hide and seek
cavemind.lore.g.p1:
RULES OF HIDE AND SEEK
(sign your name at the end)

1. The counter faces the tree. No looking.

2. Count to one hundred before you seek.
cavemind.lore.g.p2:
3. Hiders crouch down somewhere dark. No moving.

4. Do not look at the seeker. If you look, you are seen.

5. Anyone standing in the light has already lost.
cavemind.lore.g.p3:
6. If the seeker finds nobody, the seeker leaves a blown out candle and goes home.

7. Nobody plays alone.

Linh, Tuấn, Mai, Bảo, Hà, Nam, Khoa
cavemind.lore.g.p4:
(different handwriting, shaky)

It never went home.

It counts to forty eight and starts again. It counts wrong and nobody dares correct it.
cavemind.lore.g.p5:
If you look at it too long, it knows where you are hiding.

If you get too close, it is not there anymore. Then it is behind you.
cavemind.lore.g.p6:
Mother said it cannot bear anything alive that is not afraid of it.

She left a living rose where it used to stand.

It never came back to that spot. Neither did she.
cavemind.lore.h.title: Don't come out
cavemind.lore.h.p1:
I am still hiding.

I crouched down like the rules say. It is very dark in here.

It walked past the closet door three times and did not see me.
cavemind.lore.h.p2:
It knocked on the closet door.

One. Two. Three.

Forty eight.

Then nothing.
cavemind.lore.h.p3:
I did not look at it. I did not breathe. In the morning there was a blown out candle outside the closet.

So I won. I won, didn't I.
cavemind.lore.h.p4:
If you can read this, the game is not over.

It has your name now.

Don't come out. Don't look at it. Wait until it leaves the blown out candle.
cavemind.journal.m.bell:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

You rang a bell. The one standing in the fog stepped back.

He will get used to it. He always does.
cavemind.journal.m.bell_failed:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

You rang a bell. He does not step back anymore.

I told you.
cavemind.journal.m.hid:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

I could not find you. You played by the rules.

I left a blown out candle, as the rules say. Next time I will look longer.
cavemind.journal.m.lore1:
Day %1$s.

You found the fog surveyor's station at %2$s %3$s %4$s.

He too was the one standing farthest out.
cavemind.journal.m.lore2:
Day %1$s.

You found the place where I count, at %2$s %3$s %4$s.

Do not correct the number on the sign.
cavemind.journal.m.lore3:
Day %1$s.

The second station, %2$s %3$s %4$s. The boards on the window did not save him.
cavemind.journal.m.lore4:
Day %1$s.

You went into the house, %2$s %3$s %4$s. You read your own name on the wall.

Now you are playing too.
cavemind.journal.m.lore5:
Day %1$s.

The last station, %2$s %3$s %4$s. The door is gone. He wrote as far as day 2 and stopped.
cavemind.journal.m.prints:
Day %1$s.

This morning there was a ring of footprints around your house.

He walks around it, slowly, many times. He is counting the doors.
cavemind.journal.m.torches:
Day %1$s.

Your torches stand in a line now, leading away from home, toward %2$s %3$s %4$s.

He wants you to follow. Do not.
cavemind.journal.m.inside:
Day %1$s.

He was inside. A candle burned by your bed, and the chests were rearranged.

He took nothing. He only wanted you to know.
cavemind.journal.m.door:
Day %1$s.

The door you closed last night was open.

There was no wind last night.
cavemind.journal.m.sitin:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

When you came home he was already sitting in your corner.

He had been waiting a long time.
cavemind.journal.m.window:
Day %1$s, %2$s.

You saw me at the window.

I stand there on the nights you do not look, too.
cavemind.lore.m.title: The miner's notebook
cavemind.lore.m.p1:
First day down the mine.

Behind the rock wall there is a second pick, striking in time with mine.

I stop. It stops. I count to ten and dig again. It strikes again exactly on the eleventh.
cavemind.lore.m.p2:
Third day.

The tunnel I left unfinished yesterday has been dug a dozen paces further.

The torches are spaced just as I space them. Even my habit of setting them a little to the left.
cavemind.lore.m.p3:
Fifth day.

I saw him on the hill, walking the exact way I walked yesterday, stopping where I stopped.

I ran over. There were only my own footprints.
cavemind.lore.m.p4:
He is not a man. He is what this land remembers of you.

The deeper you dig, the more you build, the clearer his face. He rebuilt the house I built, somewhere I have never been.

The signs out there know when I usually sleep.
cavemind.lore.m.p5:
Whoever reads this, remember:

Do not run toward him. Do not stare at him for long. Act as if you have not seen him, and he will walk the rest of his road.

Last night someone lay in my bed. In the morning the blanket was still warm.

I went down alone. Two of us came up.
cavemind.journal.m.lore6:
Day %1$s.

You found the abandoned mine at %2$s %3$s %4$s.

The miner went down alone. Since then, someone walks exactly the roads you walk.
death.attack.cavemind.gio48: %1$s was left behind in the forty-eighth hour
death.attack.cavemind.gio48.player: %1$s was left behind in the forty-eighth hour
item.cavemind.con_quay_linh.desc1: A red painted wooden top, still warm.
item.cavemind.con_quay_linh.desc2: Linh hid it in the counting tree.
item.cavemind.con_quay_linh.desc3: At night, touch the counting tree at Linh's house with it.
item.cavemind.bi_ve_tuan.desc1: A small flame inside that never goes out.
item.cavemind.bi_ve_tuan.desc2: Tuan said it was his own sun.
item.cavemind.bi_ve_tuan.desc3: Build your own meeting place, then touch the counting tree with it.
item.cavemind.dong_ho_mai.desc2: It always reads eleven forty eight.
item.cavemind.dong_ho_mai.desc3: At night, touch the counting tree at the clock tower with it.
item.cavemind.dieu_giay_bao.desc2: Bao still waits at the bottom of the world.
item.cavemind.dieu_giay_bao.desc3: Build your meeting place below height 0, then touch the counting tree with it.
item.cavemind.coi_go_nam.desc1: Blow it and it sounds like someone counting.
item.cavemind.coi_go_nam.desc3: At night, touch the counting tree at the village school with it.
item.cavemind.manh_da_vong_am.desc1: Still warm, as if someone just struck it.
item.cavemind.manh_da_vong_am.desc2: Miner Moon: follow the pickaxe in the wall and break that exact stone.
item.cavemind.manh_xuong_suong.desc1: Cold as morning fog. Dropped when the Man is driven off.
item.cavemind.manh_xuong_suong.desc2: Fight him off during a hunt. A Blood Moon always drops more.
item.cavemind.phong_vu_bieu_suong.desc1: Keep it in your hotbar. No direction, no distance.
item.cavemind.phong_vu_bieu_suong.desc2: Click... click... faster as he comes into the area.
item.cavemind.phong_vu_bieu_suong.desc3: Frosted glass: he is at the edge of the fog.
item.cavemind.may_thu_am.desc1: Only works in the Forty-Eighth Hour. Stand still, hold right click.
item.cavemind.may_thu_am.desc2: Point where it stands (16 blocks, through walls): static and grain.
item.cavemind.may_thu_am.desc3: Drains the camcorder battery three times faster.
item.cavemind.bi_day_cot.desc1: Right click to throw. It rattles across the floor a moment later.
item.cavemind.bi_day_cot.desc2: Pulls whatever is searching for you towards the noise.
item.cavemind.chuong_gio_xuong.desc1: Hang it by the door or a mine entrance. Rings when he comes within 45 blocks.
item.cavemind.chuong_gio_xuong.desc2: Stops him sealing tunnels or spoiling food within 16 blocks.
item.cavemind.lo_dom_dom.desc1: Right click: a firefly flies towards where you need to go, leaving a glowing trail.
item.cavemind.lo_dom_dom.desc2: Shift + right click: change what it looks for (auto, page, playground, meeting point, unseen place).
item.cavemind.lo_dom_dom.desc3: Flies about thirty blocks. Twelve seconds before it can go again.
